lines.text: Would you like to see the photo show with me?
lines.speaker: Dan

lines.text: I'd love to. Are you free on Sunday?
lines.speaker: Zoe

lines.text: Do you mean Sunday the eighth?
lines.speaker: Dan

lines.text: Yes. Shall we go at eleven in the morning?
lines.speaker: Zoe

lines.text: Eleven won't work. The show opens at one.
lines.speaker: Dan

lines.text: Then could we make it one thirty instead?
lines.speaker: Zoe

lines.text: That works. Let's meet by the ticket desk.
lines.speaker: Dan

lines.text: Okay. Sunday the eighth, one thirty, by the ticket desk.
lines.speaker: Zoe
